_comment: Edit this list any time -- one player/name per entry. Names are matched case-insensitively against listing titles (first AND last name must both appear). Re-run is all that's needed, no code changes.
_scope_note: CURRENT AND UP-AND-COMING PLAYERS ONLY (set Aug 2026). The eight retired players originally here -- Jordan, Payton, Banks, Sandberg, Butkus, Pippen, Thomas, Sayers -- were removed on purpose: the interest is in active players, not vintage. Don't re-add a retired name without deciding that deliberately. Historical observations for those players remain in data/ebay_alert_price_history.json and are simply never looked up again, since comps are only built for players on this list.
_current_era_note: Bears (Williams/Odunze/Burden/Loveland) are stable, ascending, and safe long-term watchlist bets as of Aug 2026. Bulls are mid-rebuild after a full roster purge at the Feb 2026 trade deadline -- Giddey and Buzelis are the two players reporting says the team is building around, and Wilson is their fresh #4-overall 2026 rookie. Revisit this trio periodically since a rebuilding team's roster moves fastest. Added Aug 2026: Bedard (Blackhawks) is an established young star with a large, liquid card market. White Sox/Cubs additions are scoped to players who've actually debuted in MLB with a real card market -- Murakami and Crow-Armstrong are the headline names, Teel and Montgomery are the next tier down. Deliberately skipped un-debuted minor-league prospects (e.g. Cholowsky, Ballesteros) since there's no real market data yet to judge a 'deal' against.
_player_tiers_comment: Purely a display tag shown on flagged deals in the report -- doesn't affect matching, comps, or flagging math at all. 'legend' = established/retired, value is about the deal itself. 'young_core' = active young player being bet on for long-term growth, not just today's price. Players not listed here default to 'legend'. Edit freely as your read on a player changes.
